translations.text: I know where you live, where Satan’s throne is. You hold firmly to my name and have not denied faith in me. And in those days you contended, and my faithful witness [?], because every witness of mine is faithful—the one who was killed among you.
I know your deeds, your love, your faith, your service, and your endurance. Your later deeds are more numerous than your earlier ones.
Anyone who has ears should hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
You are lukewarm, neither cold nor hot. I am about to vomit you out of my mouth.
I heard and saw, and there was a white horse. Its rider had a bow, and a crown was given to him. He went out victorious, conquering, and to conquer.
He said, “Do not harm the earth, the sea, or the trees until we have sealed God’s servants on their foreheads.”
From the tribe of Judah, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Reuben, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Gad, twelve thousand.
They will neither hunger nor thirst. The sun will not strike them, nor will any scorching heat.
The smoke of the incense rose with the prayers of the holy ones from the angel’s hand before God.
A third of humanity was killed by these three plagues, and by the fire, sulfur, and smoke coming out of their mouths.

These have authority to shut the sky so that no rain falls during the days of their prophesying. They have authority to turn water into blood and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they wish.

The nations were angry, and your wrath has come, along with the time for the dead to be judged, for you to reward your servants the prophets, the holy ones, and those who fear your name, small and great alike, and to destroy those who have destroyed the earth.
It opened its mouth to blaspheme before God, to blaspheme the name and the dwelling place of those who dwell in heaven.
Whoever leads others into captivity goes into captivity. Whoever kills with the sword will be killed with the sword. Here are the faith and endurance of the holy ones.

It deceives those who live on the earth through the signs it was allowed to perform before the beast, telling those who live on the earth to make an image of the beast that had the sword wound and lived.
The angel swung his sickle over the earth, harvested the earth’s vineyard, and threw it into the great winepress of God’s wrath.
The second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and the sea became like a dead person. Every living creature in the sea died.
For they are spirits of demons that perform signs. They go to the kings of the world to gather them for the battle of that great day of God Almighty.
He cried out with a loud voice, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great! She has become a dwelling place for demons and a prison for all unclean and hateful spirits.”
I heard another voice from heaven saying, “Come out of her, my people, so that you do not share in her sins and receive some of her plagues.”
Therefore her plagues will come upon her in a single day: death, mourning, and famine. She will be burned with fire, because the Lord who judges her is mighty.
They wept when they saw the smoke of her burning and said, “What city is like the great city?”
His eyes were like a flame of fire, and on his head were many crowns. He had a name written that no one knows except himself.
I saw another angel standing in the sun. He cried out in a loud voice and said to the birds flying in midair, “Come, gather for the great supper of God.”

I saw thrones, and people sat on them, and authority to judge was given to them. I also saw the souls of those who had been beheaded because of their testimony to Jesus and because of the word of God, and of those who had not worshiped the beast or its image and had not received the mark on their foreheads or on their hands. They came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
Death and Sheol were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
The wall of the city has twelve foundations, and on them are the twelve names of the apostles of the Son.
For the Lamb and the city, neither the sun nor the moon is needed to shine on it, for the glory of God has illuminated it, and its lamp is the Lamb.
